My mantra is for students in a Taaleem school to achieve more than they ever dreamed possible. With Taaleem’s international outlook, local roots and experience in delivering the highest quality of teaching and learning, I believe each and every student under our care can reach this goal.
Taaleem schools are committed to providing a solid academic grounding by delivering stimulating and creative educational programmes within our caring, secure and nurturing environments.

The National Curriculum of England (also commonly referred to as the “UK Curriculum”) is a very structured curriculum that is designed to meet the needs of all students, stretching brighter children and supporting those who need it through differentiated teaching and learning activities.
The curriculum extends and excites all students, whatever their interests or ability. Through it, teachers are able to identify, celebrate and nurture the talents and intelligences of students.
The posts show how we make a difference. Get our latest social media updates and be part of #inspiringyoungminds

If you have a proven track record as a teacher with relevant teaching qualifications or within a professional administration support role, then please send your CV and letter of application by clicking the apply now button below.

At Taaleem, we believe that collaboration is the cornerstone of enriching educational experiences. Our commitment to excellence in education is amplified through our strategic partnerships with a diverse range of organizations, institutions, and individuals who share our vision of nurturing future leaders and lifelong learners.

pages.title: Mission & Vision | Taaleem | International School Providers in UAE
blocks: Everybody remembers an inspiring teacher because of the material difference he or she makes to us as individuals, stretching our potential and encouraging us to make the most of our strengths. Empowerment is the upshot of inspirational teaching and it sees students increasingly aiming higher and aiming more.

Together, inspiration and empowerment can be the architects of our future successes. Having charted the link between inspiration, empowerment and success, creating an environment that inspires children is the driving force behind Taaleem.
Taaleem was formed to address the growing demand for quality education in the UAE and wider GCC.
To be the most respected provider of early childhood, primary and secondary education in the Gulf region.

To inspire our students to identify their passions and talents. We will encourage them to develop holistic skills, knowledge and character so that they can compete successfully on the global stage and become responsible world citizens. Our focus is first and foremost on our students. Our holistic approach means that we place as much emphasis on the emotional, social, moral and physical development of our students as on the academic. This ensures that our students grow into well-balanced, knowledgeable individuals who are curious about the world and the cultures that influence. We encourage them to reflect on their experiences, communicate intelligently and empathetically about them, therefore positively contributing wherever they are across the globe with compassion and confidence
To be a caring organisation that communicates effectively and delivers excellent service to enable our students and staff to compete on the global stage.
